kai: heads-up — hitting a reproducible divergence on rwd-open-3b-int8-v2 when the prompt window grows beyond ~32k tokens. repro script attached to thread :eyes:

anya: ugh, can you paste the minimal run here?

kai: sure — run this locally on a machine with int8 build:
```
python -m tests.long_kv --model rwd-open-3b-int8-v2 --seq 35000 --seed 42 --kv-index-type int64
```
logs show mismatch around token 32769. snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T14:12:04Z] KV_LOOKUP idx=4294967296 mapped -> 0 (wrap)
[2026-03-18T14:12:04Z] downstream_attention: key_pos=32769 != expected_pos=1
```

tomas: that 4294967296 is 2^32. looks like some cast to uint32 is sneaking in the kernel. :thinking_face:

maria: I can reproduce on a dedicated node (A100, int8 runtime). Happens after about 11 minutes of continuous longprompt generation. started a bisect against infra/runtime commits.

kai: bisect result so far -> introduced in commit abc1234 (PR: scale-kv-indexing). the PR changed indexing type in the C++ side to "size_t" and we assumed that stayed 64-bit everywhere. but CUDA kernel still casts to uint32 in kvcache.cu line ~212.

anya: ok so we have mixing of width. probable failure mode: index overflow at boundary -> wrap -> misaligned KV reads -> output drift. fix plan?

tomas: quick patch: add explicit static_cast<long long> when moving index into device args and update kernel to use unsigned long long for lookup. also add unit test that runs with seq=40000 to assert stable logits for repeated runs. I can open a draft PR.

maria: also worth adding a fuzz test that increments index near 2^32 boundary. this will catch any future uint32 narrowings.

kai: agreed. for immediate mitigation, we can add server-side guard: if context length > 2^32-1000, reject with clear error for now. ops?

ops-bot: creating rollback candidate and scheduling patch to runtime repo. tagging @eng-ml on the rollout.

perf-bot: note — switching kernel types might affect memory layout. include perf microbench and compare throughput across seq=4k/32k.

anya: i'll take the integration tests + fuzz harness. tomas please open the PR with the kernel fixes and perf numbers so we can review. kai/maria can you validate on dedicated after patch?

kai: will validate. thanks team. :thumbsup:

maria: leaving a short checklist here:
- reproduce (done)
- bisect (done) -> commit abc1234
- kernel patch PR (tomas)
- add unit/fuzz tests (anya)
- perf regression report (tomas/perf-bot)
- canary deploy to dedicated (ops)
- full rollout after green

kai: attaching short repro gist: https://gist.github.com/rwd/abcdef (includes run script + small corpus).

anya: great context, closing loop once tests land.

perf-bot: run queued: perf/long-kv/seq-32k vs seq-4k, results will post in this thread.
